moves.Stretch: A marker travels by stretching: the leading edge leaves first, the trailing edge follows a beat later.
moves.Glide: One highlight moves between items instead of each item lighting up on its own.
moves.Unfold: A popup grows out of the control that opened it, from a soft blur into focus.
moves.Cascade: Rows arrive one after another, a few milliseconds apart.
moves.Roll: Digits roll to their new value like a counter.
moves.Draw: Checks, dashes and lines draw themselves stroke by stroke.
moves.Press: Anything you press sinks a little and springs back on release.
moves.Direction: New content comes in from the side you moved toward.
moves.Height: Content opens to its real height, never a guessed one.
moves.Pop: A small payoff lands with a quick overshoot.
moves.Spring: A value travels to its new place and settles with a small overshoot.
moves.Fade: A quiet change of colour or opacity.

entries.name: Accordion
entries.description: Panels open to their real height on a spring while their contents rise in one after another.
moves: A panel opens to its real height and closes back the same way.
The panel's contents rise in one after another as it opens.
The chevron turns on a spring.

entries.name: Alert
entries.description: Alerts drop into place out of a blur on a spring while their icon pops into its tile and draws, and when dismissed they fade and fold their height away.
moves: The alert drops 12px into place out of a 6px blur, growing from 0.96 on a spring.
The icon pops into its tile, then its strokes draw themselves.
The title and description rise in after the icon, one after the other.
Dismissed, it fades, blurs and folds its height to nothing, so what sits below closes up.

entries.name: Alert Dialog
entries.description: A confirmation that rises out of a blur, with the warning icon popping in before the rest.
moves: The sheet rises from below out of a blur while the backdrop blurs in behind it.
The warning icon lands first, with a pop.
Title, message and buttons follow one after another.

entries.name: Aspect Ratio
entries.description: Frames that hold their shape and reshape on a spring when the ratio changes, with photos that fade up out of a blur once they have loaded.
moves: A new ratio is reached on a spring, so the frame reshapes instead of snapping.
The photo fades up out of an 18px blur and a 1.08 zoom once it has loaded; a new photo plays it again.

entries.name: Attachment
entries.description: File cards with image previews, upload progress, retry and remove actions, built on UI SDK core.
moves: New files grow from 80% through a soft blur on a pop spring.
Removing a file shrinks it and closes the space it occupied.
Upload progress fills on a spring and fades once complete.

entries.name: Autocomplete
entries.description: Suggestions cascade in under the field and one highlight glides between them as you type.
moves: One highlight glides between suggestions as you move.
The clear button pops in once there is something to clear.

entries.name: Avatar
entries.description: Photos fade up out of a blur once loaded, and stacked avatars spring apart on hover.
moves: The photo clears out of a blur once it has loaded.
In a group, the avatar you point at rises and its neighbours make room.

entries.name: Badge
entries.description: Badges pop in, a count rolls its digits up or down when the number changes, and a status dot sends out one ring each time the badge's text or count changes.
moves: A badge pops in from 60% of its size.
A count rolls its digits up or down; a new leading digit rises in.
A status dot sends out one ring when its value changes.

entries.name: Breadcrumb
entries.description: Crumbs arrive one after another with their chevrons drawing themselves, a crumb for a deeper page slides in from the right, and links underline from their start.
moves: On first render the crumbs and separators arrive one after another out of a blur.
Going one level deeper, the new crumb slides in from the right at once.
Each separator's chevron draws itself as it arrives.
A link's underline grows from its start on hover or keyboard focus.
In a menu trigger, the ellipsis opens a menu of the pages it stands for.

entries.name: Bubble
entries.description: Chat bubbles that grow from their sender’s corner, with grouped messages, reply actions and delayed reactions, built on UI SDK core.
moves: A new bubble grows from 60% at its sender’s corner while its blur clears.
Grouped bubbles arrive in order, with reactions following their bubble.
A bubble rendered as a button or link presses in and springs back.

entries.name: Button
entries.description: Presses spring back, the label lifts away for a spinner while pending, and an arrow nudges on hover.
moves: The button sinks to 96% and springs back on release.
While pending, the label lifts away and a spinner rises in from below.
A trailing arrow nudges forward and draws its stem on hover.

entries.name: Button Group
entries.description: Buttons join into one strip, and a single highlight glides from segment to segment under the pointer or keyboard focus, taking each segment's corners as it goes.
moves: One highlight springs from segment to segment instead of each button lighting up on its own.
The highlight appears where it lands the first time and fades out where it was when the pointer leaves.
A segment sinks a little and springs back, less than a lone button so the strip stays joined.
A separator grows in from its centre.

entries.name: Calendar
entries.description: One key glides from the old day to the new one, and weeks slide in from the side you turned to.
moves: One key glides from the old selected day to the new one.
Weeks slide in from the side you turned to.

entries.name: Card
entries.description: Card parts cascade in, interactive cards lift on hover and sink while pressed, by pointer or by Space and Enter, and an optional light follows the pointer.
moves: The card fades up, then its header, content and footer arrive in order.
An interactive card lifts 2px on hover and its shadow grows.
It sinks while the pointer holds it down, or while Space or Enter is held on it, and pops back on release.
An optional soft light follows the pointer.

entries.name: Carousel
entries.description: Slides travel on a spring and the active dot stretches into a bar.
moves: Slides travel on a spring in the direction you moved.
The active dot widens into a bar.

entries.name: Chart
entries.description: Bar, line, area and donut charts in plain SVG and CSS, no charting library: bars grow from the baseline one after another, lines draw themselves, rings sweep round, and every change of data tweens on a spring. The tooltip glides with rolling numbers, the legend folds series away, and the arrow keys walk the points.
moves: Bars grow from the baseline one after another, left to right; a ring's slices sweep round from the top, and the others fade back from the slice under the pointer.
Lines draw themselves from the left, with their area unrolling under them, and their dots pop in after.
New data, stacking or hidden series tween every bar, line, slice, tick and grid line to its new place, with a small overshoot.
The cursor band or hairline, the tooltip and each line's dot travel to the active point, and the tooltip swings to the other side near the edge.
The tooltip's values, the axis ticks and a donut's total roll to each new number.
Stacked bars build up from the baseline, each segment growing once the one under it has; the tooltip ends with the stack's total.
A series switched off in the legend folds into its baseline while the others widen into its room.
Legend items sink a little and pop back.

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.description: The box pops as it fills and the check draws itself.
moves: The check draws itself just after; the mixed state draws a dash.
The box shrinks slightly while pressed.

entries.name: Code Block
entries.description: Lines cascade in from the left, a highlighted line's band sweeps across and follows the highlight when it moves, and copying pops a tick that draws itself.
moves: The lines arrive one after another from the left.
A highlighted line's band sweeps in from the left; the old band shrinks back as the highlight moves.
On copy, the copy icon blurs away and a tick pops in and draws itself.
The copy key sinks and springs back.

entries.name: Collapsible
entries.description: Content opens to its real height on a spring and its rows fall in one after another.
moves: Content opens to its real height.
Its rows fall in one after another.
The chevron turns on a spring.

entries.name: Color Picker
entries.description: The picker unfolds from its swatch, the thumb grows while you drag and the colour cross-fades.
moves: The picker unfolds from its swatch.
A thumb grows while you hold it.
The chosen colour cross-fades everywhere it is used.

entries.name: Combobox
entries.description: The list unfolds from the field, rows cascade in and one highlight glides between options.
moves: The list unfolds from the field.
The check on the chosen option draws itself.

entries.name: Command
entries.description: A command palette whose rows cascade in, with one highlight gliding between results and pages sliding sideways.
moves: Results arrive one after another, on open and on every page change.
Pages slide sideways as you go deeper.

entries.name: Context Menu
entries.description: A right-click menu that unfolds from the exact point you pressed, with the same gliding highlight as Menu.
moves: The menu grows from the exact point you pressed.
One highlight glides between items; submenus unfold sideways.

entries.name: Data table
entries.description: The full list screen on top of Table, with no table library: give it data and columns and it owns the search, faceted filters with live counts, the sort, hidden columns, row selection, the page and the page size, each one controlled or not so a page can keep it in the URL. Rows cascade in after a sort or a page turn, a hidden column folds away while the others close the gap, Reset slides in while anything is filtered, and a bulk bar rises from the bottom centre while rows are selected.
moves: After a sort or a page turn the page's rows arrive one after another, rising from below for Next and dropping from above for Previous. After a search or a filter only the rows new to the page arrive; selecting replays nothing.
A hidden column folds to nothing, its text blurring out, while the other columns close the gap; a column shown again opens out of nothing.
The bulk bar rises from the bottom centre on a spring, from a smaller, blurred start, and sinks away when the selection is cleared.
The selected count, the row count and the page number roll to each new number.
Reset slides in beside the filters while the search or a filter is on, and folds away when they clear.
Row checks and the select-all dash draw themselves (from Checkbox).
The current page key glides along the pagination, and the highlight glides through every menu and the bulk bar.

entries.name: Date Input
entries.description: One highlight glides between day, month and year as you move through the segments.
moves: One highlight glides between day, month and year as you move through them.

entries.name: Date Picker
entries.description: A field that opens a calendar unfolding from it, with the selected day gliding to its new place.
moves: The calendar unfolds from the field.
Inside, the selected-day key glides to its new place.
Months slide in from the side you turned to.

entries.name: Description list
entries.description: The label and value rows of a detail page, with real dl, dt and dd. Rows with a label column and hairlines, stacked, or a grid of two or three columns, reflowing to stacked on a phone by container queries. Values arrive in a short cascade, and a copy button copies its value and confirms on itself with a drawn check.
moves: Items rise in one after another, 40ms apart, with a little blur, when the list first shows.
The copy button sinks and springs back.
Copied, the copy icon shrinks into a blur, a check pops in and draws itself in green, and two seconds later they swap back.

entries.name: Dialog
entries.description: Rises from below out of a blur, then its title, fields and buttons arrive one after another.
moves: The sheet rises from below out of a blur while the backdrop blurs in.
Title, fields and buttons arrive one after another.
The close key and buttons press in.

entries.name: Direction
entries.description: A UI SDK core reading-direction boundary and toggle that mirror content between left-to-right and right-to-left layouts.
moves: After a direction change, content arrives from its new reading side with 28px of travel and a soft blur.
Content blocks follow the direction change in order.
The toggle presses in while its mirror icon flips on a spring.

entries.name: Drawer
entries.description: Slides in from any edge on a spring; its grip stretches while you drag it.
moves: The sheet slides in from its edge on a spring and follows your finger while dragged.
Its contents arrive one after another once it is open.
The grip stretches while you drag.

entries.name: Empty
entries.description: Empty states arrive part by part: the icon tile pops and its strokes draw, then the title, the description and each action rise in out of a blur.
moves: The media pops in from 0.6 and the strokes of the icon inside it draw themselves.
The title, the description and then each action rise 10px out of a blur, one after another.

entries.name: Field
entries.description: Labels, hints and errors move together: an error slides in under the field and the ring turns red.
moves: An error message opens the space it needs and rises in.
Hint and error swap places instead of jumping.
The ring and label turn red together.

entries.name: File Input
entries.description: A drop zone that wakes up when a file is over it, with new file rows arriving one after another.
moves: The drop zone lifts and its icon rises while a file is over it.
New file rows arrive one after another.

entries.name: Filter
entries.description: The faceted filter of a data table's toolbar: a dashed chip that opens a searchable list of values with counts, built on UI SDK's combobox. Chosen values arrive in the chip as badges one after another while the chip widens around them on a spring, counts roll, and a bar of filters slides its Reset in while any is active.
moves: The list grows out of its chip, its rows cascade in, and one highlight glides between them.
A chosen option's box fills with a pop and its check draws itself.
The chip's width follows its badges on a spring, so it never stretches its text.
Badges pop in one after another, from a smaller, blurred start.
"3 selected" and every option's count roll to their new number.
The bar's Reset slides in from the left while a filter is active, and out again.

entries.name: Form
entries.description: Fields that settle back while the form sends, a submit button whose label rises through sending to a drawn check, and server errors that open in place under the field they belong to.
moves: An error, from the browser or from your server, opens its own height under its field and rises in out of a blur.
The submit button's label rises out to the pending label with a spinner, then to the success label; refused, it comes back down.
The check in the success label strokes itself in.
While the form sends, its fields settle back a little and come forward again when it is done.
The submit button sinks and springs back.

entries.name: Hover Card
entries.description: A preview card that unfolds from the link you are pointing at.
moves: The card unfolds from the link you are pointing at.
Its contents arrive one after another.

entries.name: Image Cropper
entries.description: The selection springs to a new ratio, handles grow while you drag and the zoom settles on a spring.
moves: The selection springs to a new box when the ratio or zoom changes, and follows the pointer exactly while dragged.
Handles grow when you reach for them.
The area outside the crop dims, and lightens while you drag.

entries.name: Input
entries.description: The focus ring closes in around the field on a spring.
moves: The focus ring closes in around the field on a spring.
A clear button pops in when there is text.

entries.name: Input Group
entries.description: Icons, text, buttons and a count around an input or textarea, in one field: the focus ring closes in on the whole group, the count rolls as you type and a send button pops in with the first character.
moves: The focus ring belongs to the group: it starts out wide and closes onto the field on a spring.
The count rolls its digits up or down as the text grows and shrinks.
Anything marked `data-show="filled"`, like a send button, pops in with the first character and shrinks away when the field is empty.
Buttons in the group sink and spring back.

entries.name: Item
entries.description: Rows of content that arrive one after another, with one highlight gliding between the rows you can open.
moves: Rows rise out of a soft blur one after another as the list mounts, and the lines between them draw out from the middle.
In a group, one highlight glides to the row under the pointer or the keyboard focus; the lines beside it step aside.
A row that is a link or a button gives a little when pressed and springs back.
A photo in the media slot clears out of a blur as its row arrives.
A chevron in the actions leans toward where the row leads while it is hovered.

entries.name: Kbd
entries.description: Keyboard keys that sink and spring back when pressed, one after another for a combination.
moves: A pressed key sinks 1px with an inner shadow and pops back.
In a combination, the keys sink left to right.

entries.name: Label
entries.description: A label whose colour follows its control's focus and errors, with a small marker that pops in.
moves: The label's colour follows its control: quiet, full ink when focused, red when invalid.
A Required or Optional marker pops in.

entries.name: Listbox
entries.description: One highlight glides between options and checks pop in as you choose.
moves: A check pops in as you choose.

entries.name: Marker
entries.description: A quiet line in a stream whose rules draw out from its words, with a light that sweeps across it while the work it names is still going.
moves: A separator marker's rules draw outward from its words; a border marker's rule draws from the start of the line.
The icon lands with a little overshoot once the work it marks is done.
The words rise out of a soft blur; when a pending marker finishes, its new text rises in again.
While pending, a light sweeps across the words, then stops when the work is done.

entries.name: Menu
entries.description: The sheet unfolds from its button, or from the pointer on a right-click, rows cascade in and one highlight glides between items.
moves: The sheet unfolds from the button that opened it. Opened by a right-click, it grows from the exact point you pressed.
Checks draw themselves; submenus unfold sideways.

entries.name: Menubar
entries.description: A highlight glides along the bar from one menu to the next, and each menu unfolds from its title.
moves: A highlight glides along the bar from one menu to the next.
Each menu unfolds from its title.

entries.name: Message
entries.description: Sender-aware chat messages with avatars, headers and read receipts that arrive in sequence, built on UI SDK core.
moves: A new message’s header, content and footer rise in order, with its receipt last.
The avatar pops into place as the first line arrives.

entries.name: Message Scroller
entries.description: A conversation scroller that follows new messages, preserves reading position and counts unread messages, composed from UI SDK scroll area and core.
moves: Messages added after the first frame rise 16px into place.
Jump to latest rises from the bottom edge after the reader scrolls away.
The unread count rolls as new messages arrive.

entries.name: Meter
entries.description: The bar springs to its value, changes colour at thresholds and the digits roll.
moves: The bar springs to its value; the track clips the overshoot.
The reading rolls to the new number.
The bar changes colour as it crosses a threshold.

entries.name: Motion Style
entries.description: Switch the whole set between Calm, Springy, Snappy and Playful motion with one setting.
moves: The switcher's key stretches between the four styles.

entries.name: Native Select
entries.description: The browser's own select in a Keyframery field: each new choice rises in out of a blur as the old one leaves upward, and the chevron dips.
moves: The chosen label rises in from below while the old one leaves upward.
The chevron dips once on every change.
The field gives a little under the pointer and springs back.
The focus ring starts out wide and closes onto the field on a spring.

entries.name: Navigation Menu
entries.description: The marker stretches between items and the panel resizes on a spring to fit each menu.
moves: The marker stretches from one item to the next.
The panel resizes on a spring to fit each menu.
Content slides in from the side you moved toward, and links arrive in a cascade.

entries.name: Number Input
entries.description: Digits roll up or down as the value changes, and the buttons press in.
moves: Digits roll up or down as the value changes.
The stepper buttons press in with a pop.

entries.name: OTP Input
entries.description: One ring glides from slot to slot, digits pop into place and the slots pulse when the code is complete.
moves: One ring glides from slot to slot as you type.
Each digit pops up into place.
When the code is complete, the slots pulse once from left to right.

entries.name: Pagination
entries.description: One raised key glides between page numbers and the range count rolls.
moves: One raised key glides between page numbers.
The range count rolls to the new numbers.

entries.name: Password Input
entries.description: The text comes into focus out of a blur when revealed, and requirements tick as they are met.
moves: The text comes into focus out of a blur when revealed.
The eye icons swap with a pop.
Requirement ticks draw themselves as each rule is met.

entries.name: Popover
entries.description: Unfolds from the button that opened it, then its contents cascade in.
moves: The popover unfolds from the button that opened it.
Its contents arrive one after another.

entries.name: Preferences
entries.description: Puts people's choices on data attributes for your CSS, with a switcher whose key stretches to the value and the four motion styles ready-made.
moves: A preference switcher's key stretches to the value you pick, as the motion style switcher's does between the four styles.

entries.name: Progress
entries.description: The bar fills on a spring, the percentage rolls and it turns green when complete.
moves: The bar fills on a spring.

entries.name: Questionnaire
entries.description: A step-by-step form with selectable answers, keyboard shortcuts, validation and progress, built on UI SDK core and its radio, checkbox and input components.
moves: Questions enter from the navigation direction while the previous question leaves.
Each question’s title, description, answers and error arrive in order.
A single selection ring moves between radio answer cards.
The question number rolls and the progress fill grows on a spring.
Validation errors open beneath the answers.

entries.name: Radio
entries.description: One selection ring glides to the chosen option and the dot pops in.
moves: One selection ring glides to the chosen option.
The control shrinks slightly while pressed.

entries.name: Rating
entries.description: Stars fill one after another from the left, and the chosen star pops.
moves: Stars fill one after another from the left.

entries.name: Resizable
entries.description: Panels glide to a new size on a spring, and the handle's grip stretches while you drag.
moves: Panels glide to a new size on a spring after a key press; drags stay instant.
The grip stretches while you drag it.
The handle's line takes the ring colour.

entries.name: Scroll Area
entries.description: The scrollbar fades in and its thumb springs thicker when you reach for it.
moves: The scrollbar fades in when you scroll.
The thumb springs thicker when you reach for it.

entries.name: Segmented Control
entries.description: The selected key stretches across toward the new option, then closes up.
moves: The selected key stretches across toward the new option, then closes up.
Label colours flip exactly at the key's edge as it passes.

entries.name: Select
entries.description: The list unfolds from the field, one highlight glides between options and the chosen value rises in.
moves: The list unfolds from the field.
The chosen value rises into the field.

entries.name: Separator
entries.description: The line draws itself from the centre outward, then its label fades in.
moves: The line draws itself from the centre outward; vertical lines draw top to bottom.
A label in the middle fades in after the line.

entries.name: Sidebar
entries.description: An app sidebar whose current-page key glides between items, that narrows to an icon rail, and that slides in over the page on a phone.
moves: The current page's key slides from the old item to the new one, even across groups.
A collapsible group opens to its real height and its items rise in one after another.
On the rail, labels leave at once; on the way back they wait for the width, then rise in out of a blur.
Items sink a little and spring back on release.
Below its mobile breakpoint the sidebar slides in over the page from the left, over a fading scrim, and slides away when you choose a page.

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.description: A shimmering placeholder that cross-fades to the real content, which rises in out of a blur. While it loads the content is hidden from screen readers and can't be tabbed into.
moves: A light band sweeps across each placeholder, then pauses.
When loading ends, the real content rises in out of a blur, one piece after another.

entries.name: Slider
entries.description: The thumb grows while you drag, the fill springs to new values and the digits roll.
moves: The thumb grows while you hold it.
The fill and thumbs travel on a spring when the value jumps.
The value rolls to the new number.

entries.name: Sparkline
entries.description: A word-sized trend in plain SVG and CSS, no charting library: a line, an area or a row of bars from a list of numbers, with its last point marked. It draws itself on arrival, tweens into new data (a week into a month and back), colours itself by its news if you ask, and lets people scrub it with the pointer or the arrow keys while its value rolls in a small readout. Its trend and change are readable by screen readers and agents.
moves: A line draws itself from the left with its area unrolling under it; the last point pops in once the line reaches it.
Bars grow from the baseline one after another, left to right, in about half a second whatever their number.
New data tweens the line, the area, every bar, the reference line and the last point to their new places. Up to 97 points, any length tweens into any other.
While someone scrubs, a hairline and a dot ride to the point under the pointer and the readout follows them, swinging inward near the edges.
The readout's value rolls to each new number.

entries.name: Spinner
entries.description: Spinners pop in where the work starts, then the ring turns at a steady pace while its arc stretches and shrinks, the one part allowed to keep moving.
moves: It lands with a pop from 0.4 when it appears, usually in place of a label.
The ring turns at a steady pace while its arc stretches and shrinks; the spokes fade one after another around the dial.

entries.name: Stat
entries.description: The KPI card of an admin dashboard: a label, one big number, the change as a coloured pill with an arrow, a comparison line, an optional icon and room for a sparkline, with a loading state at the parts' own size. When the numbers change the value rolls digit by digit, the delta's arrow turns to its new direction and the sparkline tweens. StatGroup sets several on one surface with hairlines between them, four across, then two, then one, by container queries.
moves: On arrival the label, value, delta and chart rise out of a light blur one after another; when loading ends their ink comes back in the same order.
The value and the delta roll digit by digit to each new number, the right-hand digits a beat ahead.
The delta's arrow turns to its new direction (up, down or level) on a spring; its colour, which means status, switches at once.
A sparkline in the stat draws itself and tweens into the new period's shape.

entries.name: Stepper
entries.description: Steps that are complete, current, upcoming or in error, horizontal or vertical, as a read-only progress strip (an order) or the buttons of a multi-step form, linear or not. The line between steps draws itself up to the current one, a finished step's number gives way to a check that draws itself, and panels arrive from the side you moved toward.
moves: The connector to the next step fills from its start once that step is reached, and empties when you go back.
A finished step's number shrinks into a blur and a check draws itself in its place.
The current step's indicator grows a touch and takes its ring.
A step's panel arrives 32px from the side you moved toward, with 6px of blur, on a spring (from below or above when vertical).
A step you can go to sinks a little when pressed.

entries.name: Switch
entries.description: The thumb stretches toward the side it is moving to, then settles.
moves: The thumb stretches toward the side it is moving to, then settles.
It widens while you hold it.

entries.name: Table
entries.description: Rows cascade in, a sortable header's arrow turns over on a spring and reports the sort to screen readers, and selected rows fade in. On a phone it scrolls sideways with a soft edge.

A sortable header's arrow turns over when the direction flips.
Hover and selected rows fade their colour in and out.
Too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways and the edge you can scroll toward softens.

entries.name: Tabs
entries.description: The key stretches across the list to the tab you pick, and the panel slides in from that side.
moves: The key stretches across the list toward the tab you pick, then closes up.
Label colours flip exactly at the key's edge as it passes.
The panel slides in from the side you moved to.

entries.name: Textarea
entries.description: The focus ring closes in on a spring and the character count rolls.
moves: The focus ring closes in on a spring.

entries.name: Time Input
entries.description: One highlight glides between hours, minutes and AM/PM as you move.
moves: One highlight glides between hours, minutes and AM/PM.

entries.name: Timeline
entries.description: Events rise in one after another, a finished step's check draws itself and the rail fills.
moves: Events rise in one after another.
A finished step's check draws itself.
The rail fills as steps complete.

entries.name: Toast
entries.description: Toasts slide in and stack, the ones behind shrink back, and they spread out when you hover.
moves: A toast arrives from the edge on a spring.
Toasts behind shrink back into a stack and spread out when you hover.

entries.name: Toggle
entries.description: The pressed surface pops in, and in a group one hover highlight glides between toggles.
moves: The pressed surface pops in and shrinks away on release.
In a group, one hover highlight glides between toggles.

entries.name: Token Input
entries.description: Tokens pop into the field as you add them, and the remove buttons press in.
moves: Tokens pop into the field as you add them.

entries.name: Toolbar
entries.description: One highlight springs between the toolbar's buttons, and presses pop back.
moves: One highlight springs between the toolbar's buttons, following pointer and keyboard.
Buttons press in with a pop.

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.description: Pops out of its button, and switches instantly as you move to the next one.
moves: The tip pops out of its button.
Moving to the next button switches instantly, with no second animation.

entries.name: Trace
entries.description: Steps rise in one after another, a running title has a light passing through it, a finished step's tick pops in and draws itself, and a row opens to its real height with its detail cascading in.
moves: Lines rise in one after another as they arrive.
A running title has a soft light passing through it; it stops for reduced motion.
When a step finishes, its tick pops in and draws itself.
A row that expands opens to its real height.
The detail's paragraphs rise in one after another as it opens.
The chevron turns down on a spring.

entries.name: Tree
entries.description: Branches open on a spring with their rows falling in, and the selected row's key glides.
moves: The selected row's key glides to the new row; a lighter highlight follows the pointer.
A branch opens to its real height.
Its rows fall in one after another, and the chevron turns.

entries.name: Trigger Menu
entries.description: Typing @ or / opens a menu at the cursor, with rows cascading in and a gliding highlight.
moves: Typing @ or / opens a menu at the cursor.

entries.name: Waterfall
entries.description: Request bars grow from their start time one row after another, and nested spans cascade in.
moves: Rows arrive one after another; opening a span cascades its children.
Bars grow from their start time, and glide when timings change.
The chevron turns on a spring.
